panels.ocrText: 1. Get familiar with your BMI, find out the amount of calories your body burns naturally in a day (there are plenty of websites), and calculate the amount of calories you should be consuming that put you in a CALORIC DEFICIT

panels.ocrText:
6. Restrictions
while restricting your food
intake harshly is unhealthy,
unsustainable, and not
recommended, there are a
few restrictions you can
incorporate when it comes
to certain foods that are
high in calories and low in
volume.

For me, the foods I limited
(but didn't entirely cut off)
were oil, butter, fried food,
junk food, pasta, chips,
sodas, candy bars,
unnecessary condiments,
etc...
panels.scene: Hand holding black mug next to plate of arugula and tomato on bread.

panels.subject: body
panels.ocrText:
4. Set a goal!!
Write down your end goal
(Big goal, long term),
as well as small attainable
goals (for example
increments of 2kg) and
reward yourself every time
you achieve one, no matter
how small the change is.
and remember, weight
fluctuates! don't rely
heavily on the number on
the scale as it might
discourage you. As long as
you're doing what works for
your body, the weight WILL
come off.

panels.ocrText:
first off, weightloss is hard,
no matter what anyone
says. It takes discipline,
effort, restriction, and most
importantly consistency.

I tried every diet, every
method, every workout,
every program out there,
and saw no results.
So here's what worked for
me personally, in hopes that
it helps someone <3
panels.scene: dark gym floor with text overlay about weight loss

panels.subject: body
panels.ocrText:
3. Food Swaps!
There are alternatives and
Low cal snacks out there
that are AFFORDABLE!
Losing weight does not
have to be expensive, you
don't need those fancy
organic low cal ingredients
to achieve your goal.
Some of my favs:
Rice cakes, Vegetables,
Sugar free jello,
watermelon, chickpeas,
quinoa, fruits, greek yogurt,
Low fat cheese spread, lean
meats, etc...
panels.scene: Black bowl salad with text overlay on food swaps.

panels.subject: body
panels.ocrText:
5. CONSISTENCY is key!
Be consistent and remind
yourself what you're
working towards. It won't
be easy, and you will feel
like giving up multiple times.
Remember your end goal
and how good it'll feel one
day when you can say
"I did it".
